source.text: 林氏國有珍獸，大若虎，五采畢具，尾長于身，名曰騶吾，乘之日行千里。

inferred.basis: 原文「大若虎」只说明身量；画中借猫科头面、四足与豹斑补足未详形貌，不设额角。

inferred.item: 朱砂、赭黄、石绿、素白与焦墨五色毛皮
inferred.basis: 据「五采毕具」设五色；前朱后绿的色区、白腹、墨斑与尾部斑纹均为艺术推断。

inferred.item: 一条圆润渐细的长尾，弧长约为鼻端至臀部的 2.4 倍
inferred.basis: 据「尾长于身」作单尾；原文没有尾长倍数，约 2.4 倍比例、下垂回勾与柔软尾梢为设计选择。

inferred.item: 缓步与蓄势轻跃，尾梢延后回摆
inferred.basis: 据「乘之日行千里」演绎轻捷；收肢、短跃与落地动作属交互补足，原文未记飞行。
古经本条未记鸣声，交互低吟为合成的听觉演绎；不将后世仁兽、不食生灵之说并入本条。

sourceVerification.note: 父会话读取下载原始正文，确认source为连续逐字片段，保留五采、于和騶吾字形。正文未给出尾长倍数；约2.4倍为与既有说书一致的设计选择。

production.method: Offline reuse of verified existing Extreme-High body; local Blender tail rebuild and runtime flexible chain; no new generation transaction.

body.changes: Measured forehead horn flattened into skull; five-colour texture painted over original coat, original UV/fur detail retained. Existing mesh, authored normals, skin weights and skeleton retained; three clips rebaked with inverse circular paw targets and full sole orientation. No new tail trim.

tail.method: Local Blender round tapered surface and original procedural coat; replaces the stretched zheng-tail-max mesh entirely.
tail.changes: 144 circular rings, analytic normals, continuous adjacent-joint weights; gravity arc and restrained phase-delayed absolute tangents. Effect-owned geometry, materials and skeleton disposed on cleanup.
